_description: Full storage model specification for the ContextObjects RPS dual-collection strategy.

storageModel.description: Two synchronised collections: context_objects holds complete instances, context_objects_search holds denormalised path→value pairs for AQL queries.

stores.description: Full ContextObject instances. Each document is one instance, with the complete content-node tree stored in the cn array.

rid.description: recordId — unique instance identifier used as _id

cn.description: Content nodes — one entry per data node, in document order

p.description: Full path to this node, e.g. /data[co0001][co0002]

anc.description: Ancestor node IDs from root to this node

v.description: Leaf value; null for structural nodes

dt.description: Data type: string | integer | number | boolean | datetime | coded_text | quantity | object

indexes.purpose: Unique record lookup and upsert filter
Path prefix queries on the content node array
Node-ID lookup in the content node array

stores.description: Denormalised search collection. One document per instance, with sn[] containing one entry per leaf node. All AQL queries target this collection.

sn.description: Search nodes — one entry per leaf node across the entire instance tree. Used by AQL $elemMatch predicates.

v.description: Leaf value (scalar or structured for coded_text/quantity)

indexes.purpose: Primary AQL objectType filter on search collection
Record lookup and upsert filter on search collection
Core AQL index: nodeId + value compound. Covers WHERE c/data[nodeId]/value = x predicates.
Path + value compound. Covers WHERE c/path/value = x and LIKE predicates.

queryModel.description: SQL-style query language targeting ContextObject instances. FROM clause must reference ContextObject; WHERE clauses filter by objectType and node predicates.
compilationSteps: 1. Hoist objectType predicate to top-level $match for index coverage.
2. Each node predicate becomes an $elemMatch on the sn array, matching nid and/or p alongside v.
3. ORDER BY compiles to $project (extracting value via $let/$filter/$arrayElemAt) + $sort.

examples.label: Filter by objectType
examples.aql: SELECT * FROM ContextObject c WHERE c/objectType = 'patient-demographics'

examples.label: Node value equality
examples.aql: SELECT * FROM ContextObject c WHERE c/data[co0001]/value = 'Alice Smith'

examples.label: Numeric range
examples.aql: SELECT * FROM ContextObject c WHERE c/objectType = 'vital-signs' AND c/data[co0010]/value > 37.5

examples.label: LIKE text search
examples.aql: SELECT * FROM ContextObject c WHERE c/data[co0020]/value LIKE 'Smith%'

examples.label: Multi-condition
examples.aql: SELECT * FROM ContextObject c WHERE c/objectType = 'patient' AND c/data[co0001]/value = 'Alice' AND c/data[co0010]/value > 30 LIMIT 50

instanceShape.description: Shape of a ContextObject instance as accepted by transform/ingest.

objectType.description: Semantic model identifier (must match schema id for validation)

recordId.description: Unique instance identifier — used as _id in both collections

data.description: Node tree. Keys are nodeIds; values are node objects with _type, _value, and optional _code/_unit/_system.

_type.description: Data type: string | integer | number | boolean | datetime | coded_text | quantity | object

_value.description: Leaf value (scalar, coded_text object, or quantity object)

meta.description: Optional metadata attached to the instance
